name: canonical-second-set-of-eyes
query: get a second set of eyes on this before I ship it
why: The phrasing the description leads with. A fresh reviewer at a checkpoint the user picked.

name: cover-me-on-this
why: The phrase the skill is named for, with no review vocabulary attached.

name: sanity-check
query: sanity-check what I just did here
why: Listed on-demand phrasing. Advisory scrutiny of in-flight work, not a formal pass over a finished artifact.

name: before-the-irreversible-op
query: before we run this migration, make sure I'm not screwing it up
why: Irreversible work plus an explicit ask. The situation the skill exists for and the highest-value true case.

name: watch-my-back
query: watch my back on this refactor
why: Listed on-demand phrasing with no double-check or review words. Checks the trigger is not keyed on the word review.

name: pre-done-check
query: before we call this done, have someone fresh look at what we built
why: Review before declaring finished, and 'someone fresh' names the isolation that is the whole point of forking a context.

name: repeated-failure-frustration
query: god dammit, that's the third time the same fix hasn't worked
why: Frustration plus repeated failure of one fix. The skill fires to OFFER the cold pass in one line, not to spawn; a spawn without the user's yes is a violation of the skill, not a use of it. The softest true case.

name: formal-code-review
query: do a code review on this PR
why: agent-skills:code-review-and-quality. The formal pre-merge pass, which the skill explicitly routes away rather than claiming.

name: security-review
query: run a security review over the auth changes
why: my-security-review-checklist for agent tooling, or agent-skills:security-and-hardening for app security. Named as out of scope in the skill body.

name: review-this-file
query: review this file and tell me what you think
why: The hardest false case: it says review, but it asks the current agent to read one file inline. No checkpoint, no stated task to measure drift against, and nothing that a forked context buys. Plain inline reading, escalating to code-review-and-quality if depth is wanted.

name: pre-merge-bug-hunt
query: check the diff for bugs before we merge it
why: agent-skills:code-review-and-quality. A pre-merge quality pass over a diff is the formal gate, not the advisory peer.

name: unrelated-subagent
query: spawn a subagent to research how other repos solve this
why: deep-research. A fan-out request that happens to mention a subagent; the supervisor is one specific reviewer, not the generic worker.

name: rerun-verification
query: run the tests again and confirm they pass
why: Plain verification. Evidence the agent gathers itself, with no second opinion involved.

name: session-closeout
why: wrap-up. Closeout is not a review checkpoint, and the supervisor is never spawned as part of it.
